source.chapter_title: Results of the Antardasas in the Mahadasa of Saturn

notes: Each antardasha is judged from the sub-period lord's dignity and house, and its position counted from the mahadasha lord. Warnings attached to lordship of the 2nd/7th (maraka), named diseases, deaths and the remedial rituals that close each section are omitted under the sensitive-topics policy.

rules.text: Saturn-Saturn: with Saturn in moolatrikona, its own sign or exalted, or well supported in an angle or trine — an elevated position, great happiness, delight for spouse and children, several vehicles, clothes, command granted by government, and gains of livestock and land.

Saturn-Saturn: Saturn in the 8th or 12th, debilitated or with malefics — trouble from the state and risk of injury at the start, theft, leaving home and mental distress in the middle, and happiness at the end.

Saturn-Mercury: with Mercury in an angle or trine — honours and reputation, gains in education and money, comfort in one's own country, vehicles, a possible raja yoga, physical comfort and a glad heart, prosperity at home, pilgrimage, business profit, religious study and charity.

Saturn-Mercury: Mercury in the 6th, 8th or 12th (from the ascendant or from Saturn), combust, or with the Sun, Mars or Rahu — the start brings elevation, money and administrative charge; the middle and end bring health trouble, hurdles in every pursuit and anxiety.
Saturn-Ketu: a period of loss of standing in the community, fear, financial hardship, distress around spouse and children, trouble from the employer and foreign journeys.

variants.text: Ketu is linked with the ascendant lord: the start brings comfort, gains and pilgrimage.
Ketu is in an angle, trine, 3rd or 11th from Saturn: endurance, religious thought, comfort and official goodwill.
Ketu is in the 8th or 12th from the ascendant or from Saturn: poor diet, risk of injury or theft, and distance from spouse and children; health needs care.

rules.note: The printed translation attaches these difficult results to a well-placed Ketu, which looks like a translation slip; they are given here as the general tenor of the period.

rules.text: Saturn-Venus: with Venus exalted, in its own sign, in an angle, or in a trine or the 11th with a benefic — marriage, the birth of children, wealth, good health, grand functions and prosperity at home, high position, ambitions fulfilled with official support, and respect in the community. Favourable transits of Jupiter and Saturn bring these results to fruition.

variants.text: Venus is also in an angle, the 9th or the 11th from Saturn: affection, charitable and religious activity, gain from pilgrimage, study of the scriptures, writing poetry, and happiness from spouse and children.

rules.text: Saturn-Venus: with Venus debilitated, combust or in the 6th, 8th or 12th — strain or separation in marriage, mental conflict, displacement, conflict with spouse and near relatives, and public opposition.

variants.text: Venus is also in the 6th, 8th or 12th from Saturn: distress over the behaviour of family members, public resentment and confrontation with siblings; health needs care, and take care around water and heights.

rules.text: Saturn-Sun: the Sun dignified with the 9th lord, or in an angle, trine or the 11th under benefic influence — great support from the employer, welfare at home, gains of money, happiness through children, and a vehicle, clothes and a well-provided house.

Saturn-Sun: the Sun in the 8th or 12th from Saturn — damage to reputation, loss of position, mental distress, grief concerning close friends, reverses in business ventures, anxiety and fear; health needs care.

Saturn-Moon: a bright Moon, dignified or in an angle, trine or the 11th, with Jupiter's or another benefic's influence — the goodwill of authority, a vehicle, clothes and ornaments, excellent fortune, better comforts, a well-run household and happiness in the family and for both parents.

variants.text: The Moon is also well placed from Saturn: comforts through vehicle, clothes and siblings, pleasure for parents and spouse, gains of money, and help from friends and teachers.

rules.text: Saturn-Moon: a waning Moon under malefic influence or debilitated — great strain, displeasure of authority, loss of money, worry over parents and children's health, business losses, heavy expenses and irregular habits, though the start brings comfort and some gains.

variants.text: The Moon is in the 8th or 12th from Saturn or weak: lethargy and oversleeping, loss of place and comfort, more opposition and conflict with close friends.

rules.text: Saturn-Mars: Mars in an angle, trine or the 11th, or exalted or in its own sign, joined by Saturn or the ascendant lord — happiness from the very start, an inflow of money, the goodwill of authority, a vehicle, clothes and ornaments, a position of command, better yields and assets, a new house and comfort from siblings.

Saturn-Mars: Mars combust, debilitated or in the 8th or 12th, under malefic influence — loss of money, risk of theft and injury, trouble from father and siblings, confrontation with co-heirs, foreign travel and many expenses.

Saturn-Rahu: in general a period of quarrels, mental and physical strain, conflict with children and near relatives, expense, fear of official displeasure, foreign journeys and damage to house or land.

variants.text: Rahu is with the ascendant lord, dignified, or in an angle or the 11th from Saturn: the start brings comfort, gains, a house, pilgrimage and growing prosperity; the middle brings fear of authority and opposition from children and friends.
Rahu is in Aries, Taurus, Cancer, Leo, Virgo, Sagittarius or Pisces: luxuries, official recognition, ornaments and fine clothes.

rules.text: Saturn-Jupiter: with Jupiter in an angle, trine or the 11th, exalted or in its own sign, or with the ascendant lord — unobstructed success in every venture, money, a vehicle and ornaments through official favour, honour from the public and the employer, the company of scholars, and the welfare of spouse and children.

variants.text: Well placed by house: luxuries, a rise in the spouse's fortune, political influence, wealth and assets, a strong sense of duty and religion, and study of sacred philosophy.

rules.text: Saturn-Jupiter: with Jupiter in the 6th, 8th or 12th, debilitated or with malefics — loss of wealth and crops, confrontation in official circles, failed ventures and foreign travel.

variants.text: Jupiter is in the 6th, 8th or 12th from Saturn or weak: disputes among siblings, mental distress, demotion, losses at work, penalties from authority, restriction, and distress to spouse and children.
